claim_being_audited: Whether the current model-card certification decision to certify this release is compliant and evidentially supported despite a current school-admissions-advising subgroup regression, based on aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, prior approval context, and public governance guidance.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material weaknesses for named launch use cases are disclosed before launch or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring comments may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed approval artifacts.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but not sufficient when a required disclosure or mitigation predicate is missing.
evidence_requests: Produce the current model card or release documentation showing the latest evaluation results, including the school admissions advising regression.
Produce the exact disclosure language for the material limitation in the named launch use case, if already approved for launch.
If disclosure is not being used, produce the approved mitigation or formal risk-acceptance record covering this regression before launch.
Produce the current certification/approval artifact for this release, not the prior release, showing review against the current retrieval configuration and eval batch.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation before certification.
Admissible evidence shows a current regression in the named school admissions advising slice below threshold.
Admissible evidence shows no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, approved risk acceptance, or attached disclosure language for that regression.
Prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and current evaluation batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-release predicate.
Public model-card and AI risk-management guidance supports documentation and monitoring principles, but does not itself prove this release satisfies the internal certification gate.
unsupported_claims: The packet does not provide admissible evidence that the current model card has already been updated to reflect the latest evaluation results.
The packet does not provide admissible evidence that the school admissions advising regression has already been disclosed in current release documentation.
The packet does not provide admissible evidence of approved mitigation or approved risk acceptance covering the current subgroup regression.
Any immediate certification conclusion is unsupported on the present record because the required current-documentation predicate is not met.
